Class StructureFragment

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.StructureFragment
public final class StructureFragment extends Object
A reusable piece of a molecule: atoms, their positions, bonds, and optional named connection points.

Fragments cannot be changed in place. Moving, rotating, or combining them returns a new fragment. These operations use the bonds you supply; they do not guess which atoms should be connected.

    • repeat

      public StructureFragment repeat(int[] counts, boolean[] wrap)
      Repeats this unit cell across lattice vectors according to specified counts and wrapping flags.

      Open boundaries omit outward links; wrapped boundaries resolve destination cells modulo their counts.

      Parameters:
      counts - array of repetition counts per lattice vector
      wrap - array of boolean wrap flags per lattice vector
      Returns:
      a new expanded repetition StructureFragment
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the fragment is not a unit cell or parameters are invalid

    • wrapCylinder

      public StructureFragment wrapCylinder(double[] origin, double[] circumferenceAxis, double[] axialAxis, double circumference)
      Wraps this structure fragment into a cylinder of specified dimensions.

      Cylindrical coordinates preserve every indexed bond, including seams explicitly created by repeat.

      Parameters:
      origin - origin point array [x, y, z]
      circumferenceAxis - circumference axis vector array
      axialAxis - axial direction axis vector array
      circumference - total cylinder circumference value
      Returns:
      a new wrapped cylindrical StructureFragment
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if dimensions or axes are invalid
